refresh-interval.tooltip: How often sensors and battery levels are polled.

cpu-sensor-hint.tooltip: Chip or label fragment of the sensor taken as the machine's temperature - the one in the panel tooltip, and the one the high temperature alert is measured against, e.g. 'Tctl' or 'k10temp'. Leave empty for automatic detection.

panel-text.tooltip: Temperature and CPU frequency are deliberately not offered: a figure that moves every few seconds in the corner of the eye cannot be ignored and is not worth acting on. Both are in the menu.

show-cpu.tooltip: Turbo boost, and the governor and energy preference where the power profile is not the one writing them. What the processor is doing - frequency, scaling driver, temperature - is under Sensors.

show-devices.tooltip: Batteries, chargers and anything else connected that carries a charge.

show-sensors.tooltip: Temperatures, fans and power meters, under the name of the chip each came off, and what the processor is running at.

show-all-sensors.description: Include disk, network and board sensors
show-all-sensors.tooltip: When off, only CPU, GPU, processor-package and battery sensors are listed.

monitor-brightness.tooltip: For monitors on a cable, which have no kernel backlight. Needs ddcutil installed and permission on /dev/i2c-*, and is only used on machines with no built-in backlight of their own.

enable-privileged-controls.tooltip: CPU governor, energy preference, boost, ACPI platform profile and charge limit are owned by the kernel and applied through pkexec, so an administrator password is requested.

scroll-action.tooltip: The wheel has no screen in mind, so where the brightness of monitors on a cable is what it moves, it moves all of them together. The sliders in the menu are one per monitor.

cycle-profile-hotkey.description: Shortcut to cycle the power profile

toggle-menu-hotkey.description: Shortcut to open the applet menu

critical-battery-threshold.tooltip: The urgent one, so it is kept below the low level above. Setting it higher than that would mean the low warning never happened.

notify-peripheral-battery.tooltip: Mice, keyboards, headsets, controllers and other connected devices.

high-temp-threshold.tooltip: Compared against the same sensor the applet tooltip shows - the preferred one above, or the processor's own where none is set. Switching the unit above converts this value.

high-temp-threshold-fahrenheit.tooltip: Compared against the same sensor the applet tooltip shows - the preferred one above, or the processor's own where none is set. Switching the unit above converts this value.
